achievements.name: Jungle Hijinxs
achievements.detail: Clear the first stage and jump into its exit barrel.

achievements.name: KONG Letters
achievements.detail: Collect the K, O, N, and G letters in a single stage.

achievements.name: Puzzle Set
achievements.detail: Find every puzzle piece hidden in one stage.

achievements.name: Secret Temple
achievements.detail: Collect every KONG letter in a world to unlock its temple stage.

achievements.name: Rare Orb
achievements.detail: Finish a temple stage and take the Rare Orb waiting at the end.

achievements.name: Rambi Ride
achievements.detail: Free Rambi from his crate and ride the rhino through a stage.

achievements.name: Mine Cart
achievements.detail: Ride a mine cart from the start of a cart stage to its goal.

achievements.name: Rocket Barrel
achievements.detail: Ride a rocket barrel along its flight through a stage.

achievements.name: Two Kongs
achievements.detail: Clear a stage in local co-op with Diddy Kong or Dixie Kong as the partner.

achievements.name: Hoard Restored
achievements.detail: Defeat the volcano world's boss and reclaim the stolen bananas.

achievements.name: Gold Time
achievements.detail: Earn a gold medal on a stage's Time Attack.

achievements.name: Two Hundred Percent
achievements.detail: Finish every stage in Mirror Mode and collect every puzzle piece on both the normal and mirrored passes.
